0.content:
Koshchei created these in Hvergelmir by combining animals: wings on four-legged beasts, insect wings and casques on tigers and leopards. Many were judged failures and abandoned. Their descendants appear as enemies in the Pale Crown Palace and elsewhere in Snezhnaya.

The Eye of Graeae says the only prototypes with a shred of intelligence were Zver and one it cannot now recall. The wiki lists the Immortal Construct as a byproduct of his work on the Firebird.

1.content: One of the Chimeric Winged Lions became partly intelligent, and the Belyi Tsar took it into his service, naming it Zver. Koshchei deemed it half-formed and wished to discard it. Zver hates him for it, though it admits it owes its existence to him, and the Tsar once said he alone deserved the title of its father. Zver is said to have dragged the Tsar's body from the battlefield and now stands guard over it in Pale Crown Palace.

2.comment: Koshchei: Okurov and the Perfect Tree
2.content:
In Flamefeather Valley, Koshchei joined Okurov as "Doctor Moreau" and offered the villagers an endless life without pain or illness, the Perfect Tree. Those who joined dissolved into blue algae, himself included; a few who were experimented on but did not partake became Leshy. Furiosa and "No-Nose" Ove tried to keep others from the assembly hall. Zhara kept outsiders away.

The Eye of Graeae describes the final form as unable to move or speak, a life that no longer knows joy or love. The girl Nastya was persuaded that it was a reunion with her mother.

3.content: At Hvergelmir, Koshchei made an ear grow in Aksinya's palm out of spite. She was unfazed, said the extra organ interested her, told him to submit a request next time and gave him a watch with his schedule. It changed how he saw the world. Later he joined Pavlina and Alvis in pushing her into the Shadow Realm. In Chorus of Solace she appears at Zhara's body and says he both succeeded and failed.

4.content: Koshchei made Zhara, an Immortal Construct, from his fragment of the Eye of Graeae while seeking the Perfect Tree. It guarded Okurov from outsiders for centuries. After the Traveler defeats it, Aksinya remarks that Koshchei chose to merge it with the plants, and says she has made adjustments so its body will break down.
